assets.timingEvidence: Major energy rise measured at 14.84–14.90s, consistent with the full waveform. Low-frequency onset autocorrelation suggests approximately130BPM. These are machine-measured edit candidates, not human-auditioned beat/downbeat labels; confirm by ear before final publication.
assets.audioVerification: Decoded by FFmpeg; waveform inspected. Source has hot decoded peaks, so attenuate before mix and apply a final true-peak limiter. No claim of being a chart-famous or reference-reel song.

policy.publishingRequires: Every asset must have rights for the intended placement; attribution alone does not clear preview_only assets. Use source links instead of redistributing the raw files.

timingConvention: All seconds are source-file time. trim.endSeconds is exclusive. The renderer should trim before timing/ducking the clip. Do not confuse source dropSeconds with output placement.
